_about: The zones of the route, in order. A built zone has a scene (palette names for its sky, fog, light, unlit windows and ink, and where its fog starts and is full), a route, archetypes, names and encounters; a sealed zone only its name, year and boss. A run's graph is made from a zone's route by a seeded roll (crates/core/src/route.rs): the main path is arrival, main_fights fights, the rest and the boss; between main fights, detours of 1 to detour_max nodes rejoin the next main node, and a detour's last node holds a reward rolled from rewards, a table in which a name listed twice comes up twice as often: no name twice in a zone, and nothing the body could not use (a Pulse or Mending Parry it has, a fourth Contempt, a fifth jump, a gun when its gun is at level 5); a two-node detour holds a choice of two, and one in sealed_pct (in a hundred) is sealed: unseen until cleared, it holds a gun a level higher, or two rewards that are both yours. purse is Clemency, three times clemency_detour. Encounters are listed by tier; a main fight's tier is in main_tiers, a detour's is one higher. clemency is what the court grants per node cleared. rest_rewards: the rest node offers one of these beside its fountain, and you take one or the other. cache_rewards: the arrival offers two of these, and you take one (none when empty). weapon_steps: how many levels above the gun in hand a gun on a near and on a deep side path stands, when it is taken (1 and 1 unless given; never past level 5). minibosses: enemies each fought alone, in its arena, on main fight at (counted from 0). mission: a zone reached only on the last mission (new game plus, opened by putting the Idiot God to sleep), after the fourth zone's boss; it is not one of the zones a run is counted through, and it is listed last. course: a zone of courses, crossed and not fought (the Water Gap): its main path is its archetypes in order, the first the arrival, each with a strand off its line holding a reward rolled from rewards; then the rest and the boss; no side paths or encounters. branch_from: a zone off the main line, which follows that zone's boss on its own timeline (the river's, chosen on the Holding's timeline), listed after the last mission's zone; a sealed one is listed for what comes after it.

tour.blurb: 2031, the first stop on the road to 2081. A machine waits at the city limits to keep you from going further.
tour.arrival: The crater you came down in.
tour.market: The night market, between its stalls.
tour.rooftops: Across the roofs, from ledge to ledge above the streets.
tour.canal: A canal drained to its bed, its bridges standing over nothing.
tour.atrium: The old exchange, its trading floor under a glass roof.
tour.rest: A quiet room before the court: health, or something to carry.
tour.boss: The Court of Hours, where the Interdictor waits with its unsigned order.

names.wreck: The Wreck of the Long Patience

tour.blurb: 2046: ice to every horizon. The Witness has watched it longer than anyone remembers.
tour.crevasse: Down into a crack in the ice, and along it.
tour.terraces: A shelf of ice stepped like a stair.
tour.wreck: The wreck of the Long Patience, held in the ice.
tour.pylons: A field of antennas, still listening for something.
tour.hall: A blue hall carved out of the ice.
tour.boss: The Witness Stand. It has seen your future, and cannot say it.

tour.blurb: Calder Hill, 2056: the house where the research was done, and the machines sent to end it.
tour.hall: The great hall, two floors high.
tour.library: The library, its stacks and its gallery.
tour.lab: The east laboratory, where the work was done.
tour.gallery: The long gallery, lined with glass.
tour.boss: The Conservatory. The Executor's orders are sealed inside its turret.

tour.blurb: The mountain in 2081, and at its top the evening everything stopped. Your older self is waiting there.
tour.switchback: Back and forth up the face of the mountain.
tour.chapel: A ruined chapel on the mountainside.
tour.ledge: A narrow ledge, and the wind.
tour.boss: The Circle, at the summit. Your older self knows what happens after the clocks stop.

tour.blurb: Outside time altogether. ???? hears the Long Door opening, and its dancers keep it awake.
tour.fold: Islands in the void, and the Waiting City hanging upside down overhead.
tour.stair: A stair that climbs forever and arrives where it began.
tour.doors: Gold doorways that lead across the room, and some that lead nowhere.
tour.lattice: Rocks hanging in the void, reached by updrafts and a stair grown up a root.
tour.orrery: Rings of floor round a sun, the planets hanging.

tour.blurb: Saturday morning. Chumbles has not been fed to his satisfaction.
tour.landing: The landing at the top of the stairs.

tour.blurb: Down the river Calder from the house, through its canyon to Lake Stillwater. All platforming; the water drowns.
tour.arrival: The Spillway: the house's old weir and its sluices.
tour.spillway: The Spillway: the house's old weir and its sluices.
tour.narrows: A slot canyon forty metres deep, crossed on rings, roots and Benches.
tour.falls: A cascade a hundred and twenty metres down, rotten floors and all.
tour.shallows: Lake Stillwater's flooded wood, its roots rising and sinking.
tour.boss: The Gallows Oak. Climb it, and at its crown the Summons comes up out of the lake.

tour.blurb: An ocean inside the anomaly under the lake, and on it the Drowned Fleet.
tour.arrival: Seven ships at anchor, seven crews. Each strikes her colours when her crew is down.
tour.fleet: Seven ships at anchor, seven crews. Each strikes her colours when her crew is down.
tour.hurricane: The fleet running through a hurricane: rogue waves lift the ships one by one.
tour.rest: The Lee: the dry pocket under a capsized hull.
tour.maelstrom: Under the water, among wreckage spiralling down into the whirlpool.
tour.boss: The Eye, where Dagon rises out of the whirlpool.

tour.blurb: An alien base under the bed of Lake Stillwater, older than the Oak. The Eraser is at its heart.
tour.arrival: Down a shaft of black glass, gantry by gantry.
tour.shaft: Down a shaft of black glass, gantry by gantry.
tour.halls: Three hundred metres of white hall, and the machines that wake in it.
tour.rest: The Lock: a still white room.
tour.boss: The Eraser. Hold its pylons while your older self tries to stop it.
